name: awaken-server-local-e2e
description: End-to-end tests that drive awaken-server-local's protocol adapters with their official TypeScript/JS SDKs: managed (@anthropic-ai/sdk), ai-sdk (ai), ag-ui (@ag-ui/client), a2a (@a2a-js/sdk). Covers multi-turn, multimodal, and HITL.

scripts.test: node managed_e2e.mjs && node managed_capabilities_e2e.mjs && node managed_hitl_e2e.mjs && node managed_outcome_e2e.mjs && node managed_custom_e2e.mjs && node managed_delegation_e2e.mjs && node managed_multimodal_e2e.mjs && node managed_restart_e2e.mjs && node managed_statemachine_e2e.mjs && node ai_sdk_e2e.mjs && node ag_ui_e2e.mjs && node a2a_e2e.mjs
scripts.test:protocols: node managed_multimodal_e2e.mjs && node ai_sdk_e2e.mjs && node ag_ui_e2e.mjs && node a2a_e2e.mjs
scripts.test:durable: AWAKEN_STORAGE_DIR=${AWAKEN_STORAGE_DIR:-/tmp/awaken-e2e-store} node managed_e2e.mjs && AWAKEN_STORAGE_DIR=${AWAKEN_STORAGE_DIR:-/tmp/awaken-e2e-store} node managed_hitl_e2e.mjs && node managed_restart_e2e.mjs
